record.paper_title: Open Problems on Configuration Spaces of Tensegrities
record.original_question: Fix n and the paper's stratification of tensegrity configuration spaces by sign-preserving equivalence of self-stress fibers. Determine which subgraphs of the complete graph K_n induce the same stratification, i.e. partition the corresponding configuration space into the same strata.

evidence.quote: In many cases the strata for different graphs coincide. So it is natural to ask the following question.
Problem 4 Which subgraphs of Kn define the same stratifications?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K_n$ denote the complete graph on $n$ labeled vertices. A tensegrity framework on a subgraph $G \subseteq K_n$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is a placement $p=(p_1,\dots,p_n) \in (\mathbb{R}^d)^n$ of the vertices together with the assignment of real "stress" weights $w_{ij}$ to the edges $\{i,j\}\in E(G)$, satisfying the equilibrium condition
$$\sum_{j:\{i,j\}\in E(G)} w_{ij}\,(p_j - p_i) = 0 \qquad \text{for every vertex } i.$$
For a fixed configuration $p$, the set of all such stresses forms a real vector space $W(G,p)$, the space of self-stresses of $(G,p)$. The configuration space $(\mathbb{R}^d)^n$ is partitioned into strata according to sign-preserving equivalence of the self-stress fibers: two configurations $p$ and $p'$ lie in the same stratum for $G$ if there is a linear isomorphism $W(G,p)\to W(G,p')$ that preserves the sign pattern of every stress on every edge (i.e. the strata record which sign patterns of stresses are realizable for the given placement).

Fix $n$ (and the ambient dimension $d$). Determine all pairs of subgraphs $G_1, G_2 \subseteq K_n$ that induce the same stratification of the configuration space $(\mathbb{R}^d)^n$, i.e. that produce identical partitions into strata in the sense above. Equivalently, classify the equivalence classes of subgraphs of $K_n$ under the relation "induces the same stratification."
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in the collection of open problems on configuration spaces of tensegrities (Arnold Math. J., 2018). Subsequent literature on tensegrity strata (e.g., Karpenkov's work on strata for small n and the combinatorial geometry of stresses) addresses related stratification questions but does not provide a classification of subgraphs of K_n that induce the same stratification. No published resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems on Configuration Spaces of Tensegrities
status_evidence.snippet: Strata for different graphs coincide in many cases; the natural question is which subgraphs of K_n define the same stratifications.
status_evidence.claim: The question is explicitly posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: The Combinatorial Geometry of Stresses in Frameworks
status_evidence.snippet: Follow-up work on combinatorial structure of stresses in frameworks; does not classify subgraph-equivalence of stratifications.
status_evidence.claim: Related follow-up work does not resolve the classification.
